name: Blueprint
pitch: For architecture and systems talks where every slide is a sheet from the drawing set and the diagrams are the argument.

illustration.medium: flat vector technical drawing, white-ink-on-blue blueprint diagram
illustration.line: 3 to 4px even strokes, drafting-table precision, dimension lines with tick marks
illustration.shapes: rectangles, circles, and annotated technical diagrams, grid-aligned, no organic curves
illustration.texture: faint graph-paper grid in the background
illustration.palette_use: deep blue background dominant, white/near-white line work, one yellow accent used only for a callout or highlight
illustration.avoid: gradients, photos, rounded corners, color outside blue/white/yellow, decorative flourish
